notes.subject: ויחגרו
notes.rationale: 'gird on (belt/loins)' — KJV 'be afraid', ASV 'come trembling', YLT 'gird themselves'; literal picture is girding the loins, translated here as fearful bracing.

notes.subject: ממסגרותם
notes.rationale: םסגרות 'enclosures/strongholds' — 'close places', 'private chambers', or prison walls.

translation: Ol pikinini bilong ol man bilong narapela ples i holim smat long olgeta, na ol i belbag long insait long ol banis bilong ol.
